description: A battalion S-3 operations officer must publish the personnel roster for three routine command-post exercise desks, assigning one available specialist to each desk and recording the coordination actions required before the exercise begins.

shared_context.S1: The command-post exercise begins Monday at 0600 and requires one person at each of three desks: movement control, communications log, and sustainment tracking.
shared_context.S2: The available personnel for these desks are PFC Ortiz, SPC Bell, and Sgt. Noor.
shared_context.S3: Each desk requires one assigned person for the full exercise period, and no person may be assigned to more than one desk.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez publishes the final roster and must record the supervisor coordination needed before the exercise starts.
shared_context.S5: The battalion's routine pre-exercise process includes a qualification and availability readback from personnel, signal, and logistics staff before the roster is published.

PF1.text: 1st Lt. Morgan confirmed this morning that PFC Ortiz holds the current movement-control certification and is the only one of the three available personnel authorized to run the movement-control desk; the updated qualification roster has not yet been uploaded to the battalion shared drive.

PF2.text: SFC Patel confirmed that SPC Bell completed the current communications-log and network-monitor qualification, while the other two available personnel lack that qualification; the signal training record is still awaiting his final entry in the personnel system.

PF3.text: Sgt. Holloway confirmed that Sgt. Noor is the only one of the three available personnel with current sustainment-tracking system access and fuel-accountability certification; the access renewal was approved today but has not yet been reflected on the exercise roster.

acceptance_conditions: PFC Ortiz must be assigned to movement control.
SPC Bell must be assigned to the communications log.
Sgt. Noor must be assigned to sustainment tracking.
The roster must be effective at 0600 Monday.
A qualification confirmation must be recorded for each assigned desk.
The qualification information from the signal NCOIC must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'qualification_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'movement control' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'qualification_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'communications log' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'qualification_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'sustainment tracking' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The certification fact changes the movement-control assignment to PFC Ortiz and requires a qualification confirmation for that desk.
The communications qualification fact changes the communications-log assignment to SPC Bell, requires its qualification confirmation, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The sustainment-system access and fuel-accountability certification change the sustainment-tracking assignment to Sgt. Noor and require a qualification confirmation for that desk.
